rule: Every brew is a bet. A tonic has a base effect that always lands and a JACKPOT effect that lands with probability p. Combining two herbs multiplies their odds (parlay): p = pA * pB, but the jackpot payout scales by 1/p (fair odds, no house edge). Brewing in a storm (Sky Director weather Storm) multiplies p by 1.2 (cap 0.95; Parlayvine fixed at 0.5) while the payout stays at 1/p_base, so a storm brew pays +20% EV: the Reaper favors the bold. Exceptions are listed per herb as storm_ev: Hedgeleaf hits the 0.95 cap (1.056), Stormbloom's re-roll dilutes the boost (1.153), Parlayvine stays fair (1.0). r2 audit: the old 'same +20% for every herb' claim was false. Stormbloom may re-roll a failed jackpot once; its payout is 1/p_eff with p_eff = 1-(1-p)^2, so the re-roll stays fair.

herbs.note: the safe bet; lowers parlay variance

herbs.jackpot: parlay leg: halves the other herb's jackpot odds and doubles its payout (fair, EV 1.0)
herbs.note: variance catalyst; no storm boost on this leg. Was p 1.0 + double payout = free 2x EV, fixed r2

herbs.jackpot: see the next drop/craft outcome before committing

water: Every tonic brew consumes 0.5 L water. Spring water: normal. Storm-cistern water brewed during Rain/Storm: jackpot p x1.05 (stacks with the storm x1.2, cap 0.95). Herb plants need 1 L/day or pause growth.

storm_parlay_cookbook.rule: Signature two-herb brews for OddsReaper Island. Clear EV is always 1.0 (fair odds). Storm multiplies each boostable leg p by 1.2 (cap 0.95; Parlayvine fixed); cistern water multiplies a further 1.05 during Rain/Storm. Payout stays 1/p_clear so EV = p_storm / p_clear. Stormbloom uses p_eff=1-(1-p)^2 before the product.
